# Security

This repository builds the website of SAIL, the Spectroscopy and AI Lab at Kookmin
University (https://sail.kookmin.ac.kr). It is a static site: no accounts, no forms, and
the site itself keeps no visitor data.

To report a security problem with the site or this repository, use **Report a
vulnerability** on the repository's Security tab, which sends a private report to the
maintainers, or write to the contact in
https://sail.kookmin.ac.kr/.well-known/security.txt. Please do not open a public issue
for it.
